descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S05 「两个模式的 12 h 过期：11 h 时还在，13 h 时真删掉，Save Note、打开/关上编辑器或导入都不重启时钟」 12 h expiry in both modes: present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close or import

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Points expire 12 h after they were written; a point checked 13 h after it was written is gone (Hospital 3.6: Important Points 12 h; TC-12 step 6 repeats it in Nursing Home). …（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.6；TFA-92590 AC 6；TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 The 12 h Important Points window clears as a real deletion (queryable as gone), not a hidden flag; the window is a configuration value and the purge runs on the server.（TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-94699 AC 7；UAT 3.6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T3 A deleted Important Point never comes back unless the physician enters it again.（TFA-94699 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patients H1-H7 and Nursing Home residents N1-N4, each with one point written at T0 by server time (H4 / N3 also get a second point at T0+11 h)

When H1 / N1: check at T0+11 h and T0+13 h. H2 / N2: Save Note at T0+11 h. H3: nobody opens the app; server-side read at T0+13 h. H4 / N3: a second point P2 added at T0+11 h. H5 / N4: the editor opened and closed without typing at T0+11 h. H6: Previous Notes > Paste > Save & Extract at T0+11 h. …

Then 11 h: the point is shown and stored. 13 h: gone from the panel and from the database. Hospital: rounding:get importantPoints == [] and importantPointsDraft == ''. Nursing Home: the raw snfResidents doc has importantPoints empty, importantPointsDraft == '' and no admissionSummary.importantPoints. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-12 steps 5-6 and TFA-92590 AC 6 '12 h after they were written'; TFA-94699 AC 1 'queryable as gone' (the raw fields above, not only snf:get), AC 5 (an expired point does not come back from the draft or the editor's copy), AC 7 'purge on the server'. …

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92590 in progress；TFA-94699 in progress

医院 13 小时前写的 Important Point 还在库里、编辑器里也看得到（main 是 18 小时清，而且 Save Note、导入旧笔记、开关编辑器都会重置计时）；养老院的要点永远不过期。

A Hospital Important Point written 13 h ago is still stored and still shown in the pre-round editor: main clears points at 18 h, and Save Note, a prior-note import or opening the editor restart the clock. Nursing Home points never expire.

依据：allure 1f69e1d4: all 8 failed cells are known K1 (OAT-04 knownGaps: an 18 h window and one list clock maxed with notesProcessedAt). The NH cells are recorded under TC-12 Q1 / K14. Owners are TFA-92590 AC 6 and TFA-94699 AC 1/2/7, both in progress. The matrix ticket note from Quinn's 10-09 audit lists the same.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S05

12 h expiry in both modes: present at 11 h, really deleted at 13 h, not restarted by Save Note, editor open/close or import

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane retention：retention/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（retention/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Browser + API: H1-H7 and N1-N4 each with one point written at T0 through the editor; legs at T0+11 h (Save Note live AI, editor open/close with the clocks read before and after, second point, prior-note paste + Save & Extract live AI, editor left open); checks at 11 h and 13 h on raw rows; H3 read with no client purge; N1 editor + Save Note after 13 h. Every Save Note waits for a NEW notesProcessedAt (or preRoundError) with the page kept on the chart; a leg whose Save Note or import did not finish is blocked and its cell not judged. NH cells recorded (Fail not final until Q1). 4 Save Notes + 1 import as the scenario names them (about 21 model requests, counted in the evidence). — All legs are UI actions plus clock moves; about 6 live AI calls.

The legs the scenario names need 4 Save Notes (H2, N2 at 11 h; H7 at 13 h; N1 after 13 h) and 1 prior-note import (H6). — H5 (review asked to tag it K1 only): kept as 'K1; the editor close wrote ptsEditedAt' on evidence — in this run ptsEditedAt moved from T0 to T0+11 h on open/close (H5.openCloseClocks); closeEditor always saves ptsEditedAt = Date.now() (src/features/rounding/patient/PreRoundNotesCard.tsx:168); the first run navigated to the next chart right after Close, so that save never landed (H1 here shows the same: closed and left at once, ptsEditedAt unchanged). H5 at 13 h fails on K1 either way. The first run's N1 / N2 / H7 Save Notes never finished (page left 4 s after the click, wait accepted a missing notesProcessedAt); in this run all four Save Notes and the import finished before the next step (H2/N2/H7/N1 notesProcessedAt in the snapshots).

产品问题：A Hospital Important Point written 13 h ago is still stored, and still shown in the pre-round editor, in every leg: with no other action, after a Save Note, after a prior-note import, after adding a second point, with no app open, and after a Save Note from an editor left open. Every leg fails on the 18 h window alone (K1). On top of that, the Save Note, the import and a plain open-and-close of the editor each restart the points clock (closeEditor saves ptsEditedAt = now, PreRoundNotesCard.tsx:168; seen here when the page stays on the chart, lost when the physician leaves at once), which TFA-94699 AC 2 forbids. Breaks UAT TC-12 steps 5-6, TFA-92590 AC 6 and TFA-94699 AC 1 / 2 / 5 / 7. Known in the matrix: K1.
